WITH hits AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT w.id,w.ordinal,bm25(evidence_fts) AS score FROM evidence_fts
        JOIN evidence_windows w ON w.id=evidence_fts.rowid
        WHERE evidence_fts MATCH ? AND w.body_id=?
    ), chosen AS (SELECT id FROM hits ORDER BY score,ordinal,id LIMIT 1)
    SELECT w.body_id,w.start_byte,w.byte_count,
      snippet(evidence_fts,0,char(57344),char(57345),'…',24) AS excerpt
      FROM evidence_fts JOIN evidence_windows w ON w.id=evidence_fts.rowid

        page AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM (SELECT p.id,p.title,p.url,p.citation_url,e.revision,e.published,e.position,d.title AS document_title,d.path AS document_path,d.id AS document_order,p.anchor,p.scope,p.citation_json,p.position AS node_position,m.score,e.position AS match_position,d.title AS match_document,NULL AS hit_url,m.id AS __match_id FROM passages p JOIN documents d ON d.id=p.document_id JOIN editions e ON e.id=p.edition_id JOIN works w ON w.id=e.work_id JOIN hits m ON m.id=p.id WHERE (?='all' OR (?='latest' AND e.revision=w.latest_revision) OR e.revision=?) AND (?='' OR d.path=?) AND (?<>'manuscript' OR d.path='content/manuscript.md')) ORDER BY score ASC,document_order,node_position,id LIMIT ? OFFSET ?),
        evidence AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT passage_fts.rowid AS __match_id,snippet(passage_fts, 4, char(57344), char(57345), '…', 24) AS body_excerpt, snippet(passage_fts, 1, char(57344), char(57345), '…', 24) AS authors_excerpt, snippet(passage_fts, 0, char(57344), char(57345), '…', 24) AS title_excerpt, snippet(passage_fts, 2, char(57344), char(57345), '…', 24) AS abstract_excerpt, snippet(passage_fts, 3, char(57344), char(57345), '…', 24) AS labels_excerpt, snippet(passage_fts, 5, char(57344), char(57345), '…', 24) AS git_excerpt FROM passage_fts
            WHERE passage_fts MATCH ? AND passage_fts.rowid IN (SELECT __match_id FROM page))
        SELECT page.id,page.title,page.url,page.citation_url,page.revision,page.published,page.position,page.document_title,page.document_path,page.document_order,page.anchor,page.scope,page.citation_json,page.node_position,page.score,page.match_position,page.match_document,page.hit_url,CASE WHEN instr(m.body_excerpt,char(57344))>0 THEN m.body_excerpt WHEN instr(m.authors_excerpt,char(57344))>0 THEN m.authors_excerpt WHEN instr(m.title_excerpt,char(57344))>0 THEN m.title_excerpt WHEN instr(m.abstract_excerpt,char(57344))>0 THEN m.abstract_excerpt WHEN instr(m.labels_excerpt,char(57344))>0 THEN m.labels_excerpt WHEN instr(m.git_excerpt,char(57344))>0 THEN m.git_excerpt ELSE NULL END AS excerpt,CASE WHEN instr(m.body_excerpt,char(57344))>0 THEN 'passage' WHEN instr(m.authors_excerpt,char(57344))>0 THEN 'metadata' WHEN instr(m.title_excerpt,char(57344))>0 THEN 'metadata' WHEN instr(m.abstract_excerpt,char(57344))>0 THEN 'metadata' WHEN instr(m.labels_excerpt,char(57344))>0 THEN 'metadata' WHEN instr(m.git_excerpt,char(57344))>0 THEN 'metadata' ELSE NULL END AS excerpt_context,CASE WHEN instr(m.body_excerpt,char(57344))>0 THEN 'body' WHEN instr(m.authors_excerpt,char(57344))>0 THEN 'authors' WHEN instr(m.title_excerpt,char(57344))>0 THEN 'title' WHEN instr(m.abstract_excerpt,char(57344))>0 THEN 'abstract' WHEN instr(m.labels_excerpt,char(57344))>0 THEN 'labels' WHEN instr(m.git_excerpt,char(57344))>0 THEN 'git' ELSE NULL END AS excerpt_field FROM page JOIN evidence m ON m.__match_id=page.__match_id ORDER BY score ASC,document_order,node_position,id
